title: Prime Minister congratulates Haney on winning Gold and setting a new World Record at the Asian Para Games
body_text: Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today congratulated Haney on his outstanding performance, winning Gold and setting a new World Record in the Men’s Javelin Throw F37/F38 event at the Asian Para Games. Shri Modi stated that it is a remarkable achievement and a proud moment for Indian para athletics, expressing hope that he continues to reach new heights. In a post on X, the Prime Minister's Office shared: "Gold and a new World Record! Congratulations to Haney on his outstanding performance in the Men’s Javelin Throw F37/F38 event at the Asian Para Games. It is a remarkable achievement and a proud moment for Indian para athletics. May he continue to reach new heights: PM @narendramodi" Gold and a new World Record!
